Original serial logs, summaries, PCAPs and sequence were not rewritten, stripped or repaired. Hot raw split marker remains absent.
Kernel USBMON -32/actual1 opaque byte only establishes the UHCI/Linux reported completion value, not physical byte transmission or general hardware partial-error behavior.
